messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected from us-west-2c ELB -> backend cluster 'inference-prod' (~18% 5xx over 5m). Route53 healthchecks for us-west-2c failing intermittently. Paging oncall.

pagerduty-bot: @sanjay paged: Severity P1 - us-west-2c ELB 5xx surge (service: inference-api).

sanjay (oncall): on it. joining bridge now. can someone post immediate customer impact numbers?

maya (engineer): seeing similar in metrics: 12% of total traffic from region, error spike concentrated on long-poll endpoints and larger payloads. 90th latency also up.

elaine (prodops): customer-facing metrics: ~125 calls/min failing, several customers reporting timeouts. no external incident page yet.

ben (sre): checked ELB target health -> a subset of targets in us-west-2c show TCP timeouts and 504s. network stats show ENI TX drops on a few hosts. suspect AZ-level packet loss.

sanjay (oncall): ok mitigation plan: 1) shift Route53 weight away from us-west-2c to us-west-2a/b 2) add short TTL to failover record 3) enable ELB cross-zone load balancing for this lb if not enabled 4) replace suspicious instances and move traffic off them. doing steps 1 and 2 now.

maya (engineer): %+1 on weights. preparing routemap change. will set weighted routing: 80% a/b, 20% c then lower.

sanjay (oncall): running CLI: ```aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZZZZZ --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"usw2-a-weight","Weight":80,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2FDTNDATAQYW2","DNSName":"lb-a.usw2.redwood-internal"}} ,{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"usw2-c-weight","Weight":20,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2FDTNDATAQYW2","DNSName":"lb-c.usw2.redwood-internal"}}]}}'```

elaine (prodops): lowered TTL to 10s for the api record. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Route53 change submitted (change ID: CAAAAA1111). propagation expected within ~1m for weighted record.

maya (engineer): also toggled ELB cross-zone on this LB. confirming now.

ben (sre): spun up replacement hosts in us-west-2c and removed 3 suspected ENI-saturated instances from targets. connection draining enabled for removed targets.

sanjay (oncall): quick healthcheck script I ran: ```for ip in $(dig +short api.redwood.ai @8.8.8.8); do curl -s -m 5 http://$ip/health || echo fail:$ip; done``` noticed many fails to c-subnet IPs before weight shift. now after change see fewer fails.

elaine (prodops): customer impact dropped to ~3% failures within 4m of change. rolling incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042 (prelim).

maya (engineer): still seeing occasional 502s on large payload inference requests routed to c. suspect path MTU or network queue saturation on a few hosts. collecting tcpdump from replacement instance.

ben (sre): filed EC2 ENI support case with AWS (case 123456789). provided netstat and ifconfig dumps. might be an underlying AWS fabric issue in AZ c.

sanjay (oncall): timeline and next actions: 1) keep Route53 weights shifted to a/b until AWS confirms fabric health 2) continue replacing suspect hosts 3) set up advanced prefix caching to reduce payload sizes on problematic endpoints 4) notify customers in affected tier. starting handoff to night oncall in 30m.

elaine (prodops): drafting customer message now with impact summary and mitigation steps.

pagerduty-bot: @maya acknowledged the page. escalation suppressed.

maya (engineer): uploading tcpdump + metrics to the incident ticket and linking to pager: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9876

ben (sre): AWS responded: "We are investigating network activity in us-west-2c impacting ENIs; recommend avoiding bursty large TCP connections in the meantime." will update case.

sanjay (oncall): handing off to @ben for overnight. ben, key things: keep weights away from c, monitor 5xx rate and customer tickets, continue instance remediation, and push for AWS ETA.

ben (sre): taking over. will open a runbook entry, and schedule postmortem with infra and networking teams tomorrow 10:00 PST.

elaine (prodops): incident classification: partial AZ outage impacting ELB->EC2 path. customer impact: ~12% of regional traffic, major customers affected (3 reports). severity: P1 -> converting to incident page with timeline.

sanjay (oncall): thanks team. logging all commands and decisions in the ticket. follow-up: consider automated weighted failover policy in Redwood Optimize to handle this class of AZ fabric blips.

incidents-bot: Incident transitioned to 'mitigated' state (mitigation: Route53 weight shift + instance replacements). Postmortem owner: ben.

ben (sre): will send summary to #postmortems and schedule root cause analysis. tagging: @security for any data path concerns.

maya (engineer): quick note for postmortem: capture why cross-zone load balancing wasn't protecting against ENI-level saturation (LB config vs instance-level limits).

elaine (prodops): closing note: watch for follow-up AWS notice; if fabric fixed, we'll reweight back gradually and validate for 24h.

ben (sre): ack. updated last_message_ts and closing the slack thread when postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
